//: Gate 2 of 3: test files and repository tooling, which legitimately run under Node.
This program declares `types: ["node"]` because vitest pulls the Node ambient
declarations in regardless; naming it here makes the dependency intentional instead
of incidental. Source files are included so tests can import them, which does mean
Node globals are visible to source *in this program* — gates 1 and 3 are the configs
that enforce the platform boundaries, and they run first.
`lib` adds DOM for the same reason `types` adds node: the extension's storage tests
drive real IndexedDB objects, and fake-indexeddb is typed against lib.dom. This does
make `document` visible to package tests in this program; the `no-restricted-globals`
lint rules in eslint.config.mjs are the backstop that keeps it out of capsule-schema
and capsule-core regardless of how the type programs are arranged.
`jsx` matches gate 3 so that a component test compiles the same way the component
does. A mismatch here would let a test pass against JSX semantics the shipped build
All three gates run in sequence under `pnpm typecheck`.
